title: FOWC Terrify
text:
0

It was a bit of a terrifier. Sitting on the settee at way gone midnight, chatting to a friend forty miles away, suddenly I felt a thump in my back as something pushed the settee forcibly forwards. The settee was situated with its back on a wall in our living room. Stupidly I made nothing of it as if settess were always getting knocked forwards by a wall! Then, however, the mantlepiece began dancing crazily in front of my eyes. Then the wall opposite me started dancing too. What was this? Some kind of crazy party? I began to feel a bit dizzy as the whole room started dancing. I could hardly beleive my eyes. I had never experienced anything like this before. Then, I realised what was happening. An earthquake! I managed to type out to my friend,
“I think we’re having an earthquake.”
She responded that she was having one too.
Eventually the movement stopped. My husband was upstairs in bed and I called out to him. He said that the bed had started moving he thought, but he had hardly noticed it. Just like him! Nothing ever wakes him up!
